name: siyi.app
subtitle: Remember people thoughtfully
promotionalText: Names, context, follow-ups, birthdays, and gentle check-in reminders—kept private and close at hand.
description:
siyi.app helps you remember the people you meet and the context that makes a future conversation easier.

Add someone in seconds with a name, Instagram username, phone number, where you met, and a short note. Add more whenever you learn something worth keeping.

Today keeps timely things in order: overdue follow-ups, upcoming birthdays, people you meant to check in with, and the newest people in your circle.

Use siyi.app to:
• Save people quickly after meeting them
• Add fast updates after a conversation
• Keep useful context and notes together
• Add follow-ups with clear due dates
• See time since your last conversation
• Use relationship-based reminder intervals you control
• Search by name, contact detail, note, major, residence, or tag
• Work with cached people and queue changes while offline
• Export your information as JSON or CSV
• Delete your account and owned data from the app

siyi.app has no streaks, social scores, or ads. Your records are private to your account. You can turn on a shareable link to your own card, choose what it shows, and turn it off again at any time.
